author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from SlotsNStocks in this trailer for the upcoming deck-building slot machine roguelite game. Rig the market in SlotsNStocks. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call. SlotsNStocks will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: SlotsNStocks - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Creeper World 5, an upcoming tower defense and real-time strategy game where you fight a relentless fluid enemy. Build your base, grow your forces, and unleash massive firepower to reclaim vast flooded worlds. Face Creeper types with different physics, deploy experimental technology, and create your own maps and units. Creeper World 5 will be available on PC.
title: Creeper World 5 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Civilian Costumes Pack 1 Trailer for Halloween: The Game, an action horror asymmetrical game developed by Illfonic. Players can soon gain access to the Special Halloween Civilian Costumes Pack, packed with 14 unique outfits, 1 per Civilian, with a total of 42 tints. The Special Halloween Civilian Costumes Pack launches on October 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Halloween: The Game - Official Civilian Costumes Pack 1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Learn what it takes to be a good merchant and check out gameplay from Merchant Miles in this trailer for the upcoming sim game. Merchant Miles will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.
title: Merchant Miles - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Rasen, a third-person dark fantasy game developed by Abyss Deepen. Players will master melee-based combat in PvP or PvE encounters to parry, dodge, and attack enemies in dramatic and cinematic environments. Rasen is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Rasen - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Faraway gets a new trailer and a release date. Check out the latest trailer for Faraway, an upcoming randomly-generated, minimalistic and demanding, arcade-puzzle game about a shooting star that designs constellations to stay alive. 

Faraway will be available on PC (via Steam and the Epic Games Store), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox X|S on November 5, 2026.
title: Faraway - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from CitaDrill in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite citybuilder game. Captain a giant drill-city in CitaDrill. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew. CitaDrill will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: CitaDrill - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff? Watch the launch trailer for Flipping is Hard, a precision platformer game from developer Elegant Horse Studios. Flipping is Hard is available now on Steam.
title: Flipping is Hard - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Cyberpunk-themed action-roguelike ReBlade: The Death Spiral is dropping a playable demo as part of Steam Next Fest, and the developers are marking the occasion with this new trailer. Wishlist ReBlade: The Death Spiral on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489340/ReBlade_The_Death_Spiral/
title: ReBlade: The Death Spiral – Official Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay, enemies, and more from Forge of the Fae in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG set in a mystical Celtic-inspired world. Forge of the Fae will be available on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and GOG in March 2027.

Join Fiora and her friends as they set off on a journey to solve a series of mysterious disappearances. Explore a mystical world inspired by 19th-century Ireland, but be warned: your decisions will influence what the future holds. You might even awaken an ancient threat
title: Forge of the Fae - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Drova 2: Torn Lands, an upcoming action RPG sequel to Drova: Forsaken Kin. Drova 2: Torn Lands will be available on Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC (Steam and GOG).

The time has come to return to the Otherworld as the Dark Fog seems to be gone. The magic has returned to Drova, but a dangerous wound remains… a ravine that splits the lands in two. An unknown threat lingers in the depths.

The Divinities have been freed after the events of Drova - Forsaken Kin. The Dark Fog is gone. A ravine is dividing the land. It winds its way not only through the parched earth, but also through the minds of those living in the Otherworld. There are shadows in the dark. An unknown threat. Will those who live be prepared for what is about to come? Two factions, each built around their Divinity. It is up to you whom you will join: Will you choose to follow the Bear Mother or will you join the ranks of the Great Ram?

Drova 2: Torn Lands will feature
title: Drova 2: Torn Lands - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Cinematic Teaser Trailer for Quatiica Motorsports, an upcoming anti-gravity action racing game developed by Quatiica Studios. Players will harness high speeds across a suite of race tracks in the year 2096. Quatiica Motorsports is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Quatiica Motorsports - Official Cinematic Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Update 1.0 Overview Trailer for Enshrouded, an open-world co-op action survival RPG developed by Keen Games. Players can take a look at the new additions with the arrival of version 1.0, including the new Cinder's Cradle biome, performance and visual enhancements, combat improvements, and more. Enshrouded 1.0 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Enshrouded - Official Update 1.0 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Lair of the Leviathan, an upcoming old-school turn-based RPG inspired by classic legends such as Ultima, Pools of Radiance, and the early Baldur's Gate series. The Lair of the Leviathan trailer showcases gameplay and its handcrafted pixel world. Lair of the Leviathan will be available on PC and consoles.
title: Lair of the Leviathan - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Sparkworks Overview Trailer for Enshrouded, an open-world co-op action survival RPG developed by Keen Games. Players can get the rundown on the new Sparkworks feature, a suite of tools that let players design and share their very own creations. Build a meticulous dungeon full of traps and secrets in Enshrouded, available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Enshrouded - Official Sparkworks Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 1.0 Launch Trailer for Enshrouded, an open-world co-op action survival RPG developed by Keen Games. Players will embody the last hope of a kingdom on its knees, taking the fight to the Shrouded. Explore diverse lands, make sense of long-lost secrets, and save Embervale. Enshrouded is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Enshrouded - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the PS5 Launch Trailer for BeamNG.drive, a physics-driven realistic driving game developed by BeamNG. Players will get behind the wheel of a suite of different vehicles to take on diverse roads across the world. Speed in sedans, go off-road in trucks, and race in BeamNG.drive, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: BeamNG.drive - Official PS5 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Last Ditch Effort, a 2D action-adventure hack-and-slash game developed by Moonwell Games. Players will fight through a world overcome by oblivion on a desperate mission to overcome an endless war. Master a suite of weapons, take on bosses, and rise above death. Last Ditch Effort is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Last Ditch Effort - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Photo Mode Vignette Trailer for Stellar Blade, a third-person action RPG developed by Shift Up. Players can get the perfect pose with the game's Photo Mode, with camera controls, dynamic filters, and custom lighting. Stellar Blade is launching on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Stellar Blade - Official Photo Mode Vignette Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at the harsh world of Frostpunk in this trailer for the society survival game. In Frostpunk, take the helm as the ruler of the last city on Earth, and guide New London's flock to survival through their own harsh moral choices. Lead the last City on Earth and face impossible choices wherever you go. Frostpunk is available now on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Frostpunk - Official Nintendo Switch Launch Trailer

description:
Don't miss the Gameplay and Tactical Systems Overview Video for Cinder City, a third-person open-world PvE shooter developed by Big Fire Games. Players will get the rundown straight from the development team on the game's core and diverse tactical elements and cooperative content to take on challenges together. Cinder City is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#CinderCity #Gaming #IGN

description: On October 27, popular (and gorgeous) cozy voxel-art city-builder Town to City gives you two major new – and highly requested – tools to help shape your 19th century Mediterranean towns: customizable houses and upgraded roads. Check out this new trailer for your first look, and grab Town to City on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115220/Town_to_City/

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Derelikt, a retro sci-fi horror first-person shooter developed by Visuwyg. Players will fight aboard the Von Neumann Outpost, a remote station on an asteroid in Saturn's orbit. Explore sprawling halls full of enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and make use of an array of weapons to survive. Derelikt is launching on November 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Derelikt - Official Release Date Trailer

description:
Don't miss the Zenith Update Launch Trailer for Saros, the hit third-person action roguelike shooter developed by Housemarque. Players can access new replayable game modes, online leaderboards, and more that put seasoned players to the ultimate test. Take on Overlord enemies in Overlord Rush to attain a high score in the Zenith Update for Saros, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#Saros #Gaming #IGN
title: Saros - Official Zenith Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Steam Next Fest Trailer for Ghost Justice, an upcoming modern turn-based tactical strategy set in the heart of a brutal narco war. In Ghost Justice, you lead an elite task force through dangerous operations against ruthless drug cartels across urban districts and dense jungle territories, where every decision can determine the outcome of the mission. Ghost Justice will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Ghost Justice - Official Steam Next Fest Trailer
